subject: Dedicated Capacity playbook kickoff — roles, deliverables, and POC timeline
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Lee <sam.lee@atlasai.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom@atlasai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Jul 2028 15:34:00 -0700
Subject: Dedicated Capacity playbook kickoff — roles, deliverables, and POC timeline

Hi Samantha / Tom —

Thanks again for the productive call last week. Per our discussion, I wanted to kick off a short, focused mutual action plan (we're calling it the "Dedicated Capacity playbook") to align on who does what, what success looks like for your POC, and a proposed timeline for close.

High-level goal:
- Validate dedicated GPU capacity, throughput targets, and latency SLOs for AtlasAI's real-time summarization workload; decision to move forward by end of August.

Proposed POC acceptance criteria (suggested):
- Sustained 180–220 QPS on 512-token average requests with p95 latency < 220ms
- Cost estimate within target band (we'll share tuned config)
- No functional regressions compared to AtlasAI's current baseline (sample prompt set)

Roles & initial owners:
- Customer lead: Samantha Lee (AtlasAI) — validation, sample prompt set, ops point of contact
- Redwood solution lead: Lauren Bishop — MAP owner, commercial & rollout coordination
- Redwood infra lead: Aditya Rao — GPU pool sizing, instance sizing recommendations
- Redwood performance engineer: Marissa Cole — benchmark harness, test runs, result analysis
- Customer success / onboarding: Monica Patel — deployment checklist, runbook
- Integration owner (optional): Jordan Blake — API contract, auth, and network setup

Attachments I've included: DedicatedCapacity_Playbook_v0.1.xlsx (MAP template + milestone schedule) and POC-benchmark-specs.md (benchmark harness + sample prompts). Please review and let me know if anything should be re-prioritized.

Proposed timeline (flexible):
- Week 0 (this week): Confirm roles, sign off on acceptance criteria, share credentials & sample data
- Week 1: Redwood runs initial perf sweep (internal), Atlas provides final prompt set
- Week 2: Joint POC runs (3-day concentrated runs + monitoring)
- Week 3: Results review and decision meeting — go/no-go on capacity reservation

Can we lock a 30–45 minute slot on Thursday (7/13) for a quick alignment and to sign the MAP? If that works for you I'll send a calendar invite with a short agenda.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

—
Lauren Bishop
Senior Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0134

From: Samantha Lee <sam.lee@atlasai.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom@atlasai.com>, procurement@atlasai.com
Date: Tue, 11 Jul 2028 17:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated Capacity playbook kickoff — roles, deliverables, and POC timeline

Thanks Lauren — this looks good and nicely scoped. A few quick notes from our side: 

- Acceptance criteria: the latency p95 target looks right, but we need a p99 target as well (suggest p99 < 480ms).
- Throughput: 200 QPS sustained is our target for the high-volume lane; please show config for both 200 QPS and a 1k-concurrent short-burst scenario.
- Data: we'll provide an anonymized sample prompt set (approx 40k tokens) and a small holdout for regression checks.

Availability: Thursday 7/13 11am PT works for Samantha and Tom. Procurement (procurement@atlasai.com) is looped just for timelines/contract redlines — they won't need to attend the kickoff call.

Thanks — excited to get started.

Best,
Sam
Samantha Lee
Head of Platform | AtlasAI
sam.lee@atlasai.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Lee <sam.lee@atlasai.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Jul 2028 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated Capacity playbook kickoff — roles, deliverables, and POC timeline

Great — noted on p99. I'll prepare two benchmark configurations:

1) Baseline: steady 200 QPS, 512-token avg, target p95 <220ms, p99 <480ms.
2) Burst: simulated burst mode (1k concurrent short requests) to validate cache/kv and burst capacity behavior; we'll capture tail latencies and GPU utilization.

I'll attach the initial run commands and the harness config to the Drive link by EOD. Aditya: can you propose initial pool sizing (GPU type and count) for both configs? I'm thinking 4x A100-80GB equivalent for baseline and an additional 2x for burst headroom, but I'll rely on your sizing.

—Marissa
Senior Performance Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Samantha Lee <sam.lee@atlasai.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom@atlasai.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Jul 2028 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated Capacity playbook kickoff — roles, deliverables, and POC timeline

Thanks — quick sizing note from infra:

- For the steady-200 QPS profile we recommend starting with 3x A100-80GB (quantized model build) behind a single serving cluster with continuous batching and prefix caching enabled. That should give headroom for model KV cache and steady-state throughput.
- For the burst scenario, we can pre-warm 1–2 extra nodes and enable autoscale burst policy (burst duration cap: 10 minutes) — items to validate during joint runs.
- Estimated instance-hours for a 2-week active POC (including verification runs): ~540 instance-hours across the pool. We'll convert to an estimated cost and include in the playbook.

I'll add a short section to the playbook spreadsheet with these recommendations and the assumptions (model size, quantization level, avg seq len).

-Aditya
Head of Inference Infrastructure | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com

From: Tom Alvarez <tom@atlasai.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Samantha Lee <sam.lee@atlasai.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated Capacity playbook kickoff — roles, deliverables, and POC timeline

Thanks all — this reads well. A couple of asks from AtlasAI ops before the Thursday sync: 

- Network/IP allowlist + egress checklist (we'll send our infra contact details to Jordan).
- Can Redwood provide a short runbook for failover behavior if a node drops mid-run? We want to understand how requests are re-routed and if we need to buffer on our side.
- Procurement wants a ballpark of committed hours and an early estimate of monthly reserved capacity pricing so they can prep redlines; procurement@atlasai.com is on copy.

We'll be on the 7/13 11am PT call. See you then.

Tom
VP, Site Reliability | AtlasAI
